scripts.deploy: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate:local: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply outreach-copilot-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply outreach-copilot-db --remote
